entry.name: AddedImages
entry.label: Image URLs and folder URLs ending in a slash, picked from along with the bundled pictures

entry.name: UncheckedPictures
entry.label: Bundled ids and image URLs, folders' images among them, not to show

entry.name: Picture
entry.label: Before 1.3: id of a bundled picture, or "custom"

entry.name: CustomImage
entry.label: Before 1.3: URL of the image used when Picture is "custom"

entry.name: ImageWidth
entry.label: Cells a custom image is scaled to across

entry.name: Brightness
entry.label: Mid-tone shift for the black and white conversion, -100..100

entry.name: Contrast
entry.label: Contrast for the black and white conversion, percent

entry.name: Dither
entry.label: Ordered dither instead of a plain threshold

entry.name: Theme
entry.label: 0 is the drifting spectrum, N pins palette N-1

entry.name: StopAfterIntro
entry.label: Glide to a halt after the first scene and stay still

entry.name: ReplayMinutes
entry.label: Replay a scene this often once stopped, 0 never

entry.name: PixelSize
entry.label: Screen pixels per bitmap cell, 0 picks it from the screen width

entry.name: Gap
entry.label: Gap between tiles, percent of a cell

entry.name: TileOpacity
entry.label: How dark a tile is against the background, percent

entry.name: ShadowSoftness
entry.label: How far a shadow fades out past its tile, percent of a cell

entry.name: ShadowStrength
entry.label: How much the darkest part of a shadow darkens the background, percent

entry.name: AppearSoftness
entry.label: 0 sweeps the tiles in as a sharp wave, 100 grows them all at once
